I did, however, experience phantom nut pain once they removed righty. I also experienced pain in lefty several months after surgery, which caused severe anxiety. I think between abnomalities in physiology (cists) and the fact that your brain is capable of manifesting pain that isn't really there, it can be very difficult to know what to really be worried about. My biggest suggestion is to ask a shit ton of questions, even if you think they are stupid. Write these questions down before hand because it can be difficult to remember everything when a Dr is fondling your berries. Also, and this may sound really odd, but if you have someone you have discussed this with, or have family that is in the medical field, bring them with into the appointment...if you can.
